old: No free plan and no yearly plan. The pricing page lists one price, '$8.00/ month', and the FAQ says 'Obscura is just $8/month.' Subscriptions renew monthly by card; time can also be added by top-up with a card, Bitcoin Lightning or Monero. A promotion on the home page ('No Nord November') offers a free trial that matches the time left on another VPN plan.
